title: Kubernetes Enumeration: A Read-Only Cheat Sheet
caption: Kubernetes Enumeration: a visual walkthrough of every control-plane and node service, what runs, where it listens, and how to check it safely.
description: A seven-step, read-only loop for enumerating a Kubernetes cluster: scope, discover, inventory, confirm config, read-only checks, record and correlate. Every command, why it is run, and the port quick reference.
